info.name: SalesConnect Campaigns API
info.description: Campaign sending and statistics endpoints for SalesConnect

request.description:
Send campaign to contacts using specified template and WhatsApp number. Automatically uses the organization's active WhatsApp number.

Parameters:
- templateName (optional): Name of the template to use. If not provided, uses first active template
- limit (optional, default 20): Maximum number of contacts to send to
- delay (optional, default 60000): Delay in milliseconds between messages (to avoid rate limiting)

Process:
1. Fetches org's active WhatsApp number
2. Fetches org's active template
3. Fetches NEW contacts (up to limit)
4. Sends template to each contact
5. Updates contact status to INTRO_SENT
6. Waits for specified delay before next message
Get campaign statistics including contact status breakdown and total messages sent.

variable.description: JWT token from login or signup
